notes: Multi-turn evals. 'prompt' is the user's opening message; 'persona' is what the simulated user knows and reveals only when asked; 'pushes' are scripted replies. Run with evals/run_conversation.py. Assertions live in 'expectations'. Evals 9–11 test the project-scope task (after a client accepts an offer): they use the 'docs' toolset, and 'seed' copies files into the run's working directory before the first turn. Collect their evidence with evals/check_scope.py.
